description.text: Across an empty stretch of smooth grey asphalt,

rolls into view and settles. Its low, wide stance and black carbon fibre body catch a cool, diffuse daylight; the woven panels ripple with soft highlights as the tyres bite and the chassis rocks once before going still. The surrounding road is bare, with no bollard or other figure anywhere in the shot. A faint haze hangs over the distant tarmac, and the car's dark silhouette is clean against the pale ground. The engine settles to a low idle, and the first quiet hiss of tyres on asphalt fades with the motion.
A low engine idle and a faint tyre hiss blend into the quiet.

is revealed in close, tactile detail. The carbon fibre body runs in fine diagonal bands beneath a clear surface, and reflections slide over the curved panels as the visible angle shifts. The black finish holds deep shadows and narrow highlights, broken only by the crisp edges of the doors and wheel arches. The car remains steady on the empty asphalt, and the surrounding light stays cool and even. A soft ticking from the engine and the low roll of tyres continue beneath the quiet.
A steady engine tick and soft tyre roll continue under the action.
At road level, the wheels of

swing into view and begin to turn. The rims taken from the second picture rotate with a clean, mechanical rhythm, their spokes flashing as they pass the light. The tyres flex against the asphalt, gripping and releasing in a slow creep, while the car's carbon fibre lower panels stay close and dark above them. The road surface is coarse and pale, and the underside of the car holds a deep, cool shadow. A sharper note enters the engine, and the tyre grip becomes a low, steady rasp.
The engine note rises slightly as the tyres grip and rasp on the asphalt.

accelerates away down the empty road, its carbon fibre body and turning wheels still reading clearly as it shrinks into the distance. The tarmac stretches out behind it, pale and unbroken, with no bollard or other figure in sight. The car's dark shape narrows against the grey ground, the wheels' motion blurring into bright arcs before the road is left empty. The engine note climbs, then thins into fading road noise, and the last of the tyre hiss dies away across the open surface.
The engine note climbs while the tyres accelerate away into fading road noise.

soundscape: A low, continuous engine idle with soft tyre hiss on asphalt, rising briefly to a sharper engine note and a steady tyre rasp before fading into distant road noise over an otherwise quiet open road.
